details:
Mission Architect: STARK Aerospace Systems Engineering and Planetary Simulator is an interactive space exploration and spacecraft engineering game. The main objective of this game is to design, build, launch, and operate a spacecraft to explore different planets and complete scientific missions.

The game allows players to explore different destinations, such as Earth, the Moon, Mars, and Europa. Players can select a mission, choose a suitable spacecraft, and customize its components, including the power generation system, battery, propulsion engine, thermal control, radiation shielding, communication system, and scientific instruments.

After designing the spacecraft, players must check its mass, power consumption, fuel requirements, communication systems, and mission budget. Once all systems are verified, they can proceed with the launch sequence and control the spacecraft during its journey through space.

The game also includes a Flight Simulation and Operations section, where players can monitor spacecraft temperature, battery level, altitude, orbital velocity, radiation levels, and scientific data. Players can control different spacecraft systems, adjust simulation speed, and respond to unexpected space events.

Another important feature is the STARK Data Lab, which provides scientific information related to planetary exploration and space research. At the end of each mission, the Mission Debrief section evaluates the spacecraft's performance and provides an overall mission grade.

Mission Architect is an educational and interactive space simulation game that combines science, technology, engineering, and exploration. It provides players with an opportunity to experience the process of planning a space mission, designing a spacecraft, and exploring the solar system in a virtual environment. The game makes learning about aerospace engineering more interesting, practical, and enjoyable.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) was used for the development of this project.
